title: Viterbi Decoder
source_docs: Communications Toolbox HDL Support/Error Detection and Correction/Convolutional/Viterbi_Decoder.md
Wireless HDL Toolbox/Error Detection and Correction/Viterbi_Decoder.md
text: 使用 Viterbi 算法解码卷积编码数据，输入 3 路、输出 1 路；按 {Decision type} 指定解码器判决类型；{Trellis structure} 指定卷积码的网格描述 poly2trellis、{numInputSymbols} 指定输入到编码器的符号数 2 K、{numOutputSymbols} 指定从编码器输出的符号数 2 N、{numStates} 指定编码器中的状态数 power、{nextStates} 指定下一状态 matrix of integers、{outputs} 输出 matrix、{Punctured code} 启用代码打孔指定、{Puncture vector} 指定打孔模式向量、{Enable erasures input port} 用于启用删除输入端口、{Number of soft decision bits} 指定 Soft input word length、{Error if quantized input values are out of range} 指定 Option to error if quantized input values are out、{Traceback depth}、{Operation mode} 指定编码帧的终止方法、{Enable reset input port} 指定 Option to add reset input port、{Delay reset action to next time step} 指定将复位操作延迟到下一时间步、{State metric word length}、{Output data type} 输出数据类型 Inherit via internal，按实例取值。

ports.name: In
ports.summary: 卷积编码后的码字 column vector

ports.name: Era
ports.summary: 码字中的删除比特 binary-valued vector

ports.name: Rst
ports.summary: 重置解码器寄存器状态的选项 scalar

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: 输出消息 binary column vector

params.name: Trellis structure
params.values: 卷积码的网格描述 poly2trellis(7,[171 133]) (default)

params.name: numInputSymbols
params.values: 输入到编码器的符号数 2 K

params.name: numOutputSymbols
params.values: 从编码器输出的符号数 2 N

params.name: numStates
params.values: 编码器中的状态数 power of 2

params.name: nextStates
params.values: 下一状态 matrix of integers

params.name: outputs
params.values: 输出 matrix of octal numbers

params.name: Punctured code
params.values: 启用代码打孔指定的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Enable erasures input port
params.values: 用于启用删除输入端口的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Decision type
params.values: 解码器判决类型 Unquantized (default) | Hard decision | Soft decision

params.name: Number of soft decision bits
params.values: Soft input word length 4 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Error if quantized input values are out of range
params.values: Option to error if quantized input values are out of range off (default) | on

params.name: Operation mode
params.values: 编码帧的终止方法 Continuous (default) | Truncated | Terminated

params.name: Enable reset input port
params.values: Option to add reset input port off (default) | on

params.name: Delay reset action to next time step
params.values: 将复位操作延迟到下一时间步的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: State metric word length
params.values: State metric word length 16 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Output data type
params.values: 输出数据类型 Inherit via internal rule (default) | Smallest unsigned integer | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean
